name: Fiat
intro: Fiat originated in Italy. This course teaches selected recognizable model families, organized by the jobs they do. It is a guided starting map, not a claim that these are every current or historical model.
naming: Fiat originated in Italy and is known for small-car families. 500 is a family name, not engine displacement. The e in 500e identifies electric positioning; Abarth is a separate performance identity used on particular products.
warning: The families below are selected for learning and recognition. Check the linked official range for current Canadian availability, model years, equipment and pricing. A familiar name may remain on used cars after new-car availability changes.

models.name: 500 — earlier gas models
models.role: Small Fiat to recognize used and on the road
models.explanation: Earlier Fiat 500 models use a compact rounded body with gas-engine configurations. A used gas 500 is not an electric 500e just because the shape looks related.
models.tradeoff: The 500 — earlier gas models belongs in a comparison for small fiat to recognize used and on the road. Check actual passenger fit, cargo access, exterior dimensions and the exact version’s running costs. Its category is a starting point, not a promise that it fits every person or task.
models.compare: Compare year, condition, body and exact engine/transmission. An earlier gas version and a new electric one need different fuel/charging and servicing questions.
models.memory: 500 = small rounded family; check gas or electric
models.scenario: A friend mentions a 500 — earlier gas models. Explain its role as small fiat to recognize used and on the road, then ask for the year, powertrain and equipment before comparing it with another Fiat.
models.power: Check the exact Canadian model year and version for the available engine, hybrid or electric system. Do not infer the powertrain from the family name alone.

models.name: 500e
models.explanation: 500e identifies Fiat’s small electric car role. Electric propulsion does not by itself tell you how far it will travel on your route or how conveniently you can charge it.
models.tradeoff: The 500e belongs in a comparison for fiat electric city-car role. Check actual passenger fit, cargo access, exterior dimensions and the exact version’s running costs. Its category is a starting point, not a promise that it fits every person or task.
models.compare: Compare exact range and charging specifications, rear-seat/cargo needs and availability. A small exterior can suit some city tasks while limiting passenger and luggage flexibility.
models.scenario: A friend mentions a 500e. Explain its role as fiat electric city-car role, then ask for the year, powertrain and equipment before comparing it with another Fiat.
models.power: Check the exact Canadian model year and version for the available engine, hybrid or electric system. Do not infer the powertrain from the family name alone.

models.name: 500X — road & used-car recognition
models.explanation: 500X is a different crossover family from the small 500 hatchback. It is included for recognition of used and older vehicles, not as a promise of current Canadian new-car availability.
models.tradeoff: The 500X — road & used-car recognition belongs in a comparison for fiat crossover recognition family. Check actual passenger fit, cargo access, exterior dimensions and the exact version’s running costs. Its category is a starting point, not a promise that it fits every person or task.
models.compare: Compare the actual body, dimensions and year. The shared 500 name does not mean the hatchback and crossover have identical engines or equipment.
models.memory: 500X = crossover, not just a hatchback trim
models.scenario: A friend mentions a 500X — road & used-car recognition. Explain its role as fiat crossover recognition family, then ask for the year, powertrain and equipment before comparing it with another Fiat.
models.power: Check the exact Canadian model year and version for the available engine, hybrid or electric system. Do not infer the powertrain from the family name alone.
